_comment: Rule tables for scripts/bundle_analyzer.py. Sizes are rough minified figures.

moment.reason: Large locale files bundled by default

lodash.alternative: lodash-es with tree-shaking or individual imports (lodash/get)
lodash.reason: Full library often imported when only few functions needed

jquery.alternative: Native DOM APIs or React/Vue patterns

axios.reason: Fetch API covers most use cases

underscore.reason: Most utilities now in standard JavaScript

chart.js.reason: Consider if you need all chart types

three.alternative: None - use dynamic import for 3D features

package_optimizations.react-icons: Import individual icons: import { FaHome } from 'react-icons/fa'
package_optimizations.lucide-react: Already tree-shakeable, add to optimizePackageImports in next.config.js
package_optimizations.framer-motion: Use dynamic import for non-critical animations
package_optimizations.recharts: Consider lazy loading for dashboard charts

import_patterns: Avoid import * from lodash, use individual imports
Consider replacing moment with date-fns or dayjs
Import icons from specific icon sets (react-icons/fa)
